old_problem: The prior record treated device mapping, release-specific parameter confirmation, counter delta and recovery as an unresolved Engineering Decision. The Master unambiguously defines a correctable UMC on-die ECC one-shot at address 0x800 and its observable success/counter/log behavior. ED-16 makes the missing target and authorization strict execution prerequisites, not a reason to leave the review itself pending.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires an approved amdgpuras release, isolated SUT, exact immutable GPU target and recovery; ED-03 parameterizes device0-to-UUID/BDF/OAM and release-specific tuple semantics; ED-17 preserves existing counters/logs; ED-15 strengthens `nonzero` to an attributable before/after delta without changing coverage. The source command and oracle remain intact and no injection is pre-authorized.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row452 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3041 and next formal queue row453/history3042.
The exact tuple `-d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 2 -a 0x800` uniquely identifies this correctable ODECC case and must not be merged with the subtype0/type4 or subtype2/type4 replay rows.

A post-count merely being nonzero is insufficient when prior errors exist; the same mapped GPU/block requires a preserved pre-count and timestamp-correlated positive delta plus correctable UMC evidence.

Linux AMDGPU RAS documentation confirms that RAS state and counters are per driver/device context; driver lifecycle and module parameters must be recorded instead of silently reloading or clearing logs.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row453 and verified its manifest identity; no modprobe, injection, query, reset, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: AMD UMC correctable ODECC in-band one-shot injection at 0x800
test_case.purpose: Inject exactly one approved UMC correctable on-die ECC event at address 0x800 into the mapped AMD GPU and prove an attributable UMC counter delta and correctly classified OS/BMC evidence while the GPU remains healthy and recoverable.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras >=1.3.4 release/checksum and GPU/driver/firmware support matrix
Device0/card/serial/UUID/BDF/OAM mapping for a dedicated idle SUT
Approved amdgpu `ras_enable=1` driver lifecycle and saved prior module/driver state
AMD/FAE confirmation that block0/subtype2/type2/address0x800 means the intended correctable ODECC stimulus
Expected counter delta and dmesg/SEL/CPER classification plus OOB abort/recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Preserve existing dmesg, SEL/CPER and the mapped GPU's UMC counter without clearing them. Record current amdgpu module parameters and only apply `modprobe amdgpu ras_enable=1` through the approved driver lifecycle. Reconfirm that device0 maps to the authorized UUID/BDF/OAM, query `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1`, and at the explicit one-shot hold point execute `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 2 -t 2 -a 0x800` once. Immediately query the same counter, capture timestamped kernel/BMC evidence and GPU health, then perform only the approved cleanup/recovery. Never retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact one-shot command returns the approved success indication, the same GPU/block UMC correctable counter increases by the approved delta, correlated logs identify a correctable UMC ODECC event rather than an uncorrectable escalation, and the GPU remains enumerated, accessible and within health/thermal limits after cleanup.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable device0 identity, approved tuple semantics, preserved baseline, exact command/output/exit/time, attributable UMC counter delta, correctable UMC log/SEL/CPER classification and healthy recovery. A generic hardware-error line, success string or nonzero post-count alone cannot pass; any second injection invalidates the one-shot run.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, OOB access and separate explicit approval for driver lifecycle, one injection and any recovery reset
Confirm device0-to-UUID/BDF/OAM immediately before the command
Preserve pre-existing counters/logs and abort on uncorrectable escalation, GPU loss, hang, thermal or power limits
Do not change the tuple, clear evidence or retry automatically
expected_evidence: Driver/module/RAS state and preserved per-GPU UMC/log baseline
Exact injection command/output/exit/timestamp and same-block pre/post counter values
Correlated correctable UMC dmesg/SEL/CPER evidence and no fatal escalation
GPU enumeration/health/thermal state, cleanup/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On target mismatch, failed/ambiguous injection, uncorrectable escalation, GPU loss, hang or health limit, stop immediately, preserve all state and use OOB plus the AMD-approved recovery path. Restore only the saved driver state when authorized; do not clear counters/logs or inject again.
